02 · How we deliver

Clear steps. No surprises.

We speak with your team first, show you the whole flow before we build, and test with real shipments before launch.

01Discover

We speak with your stakeholders

  • Sessions with management, operations, finance and the ATM team
  • Walk through how a shipment and an ATM job run today
  • Review Zoho Books, Outlook and the documents you use
  • Agree goals, priorities and what success looks like
02Design

You see the whole flow before we build

  • Map every step from request to delivery
  • Clickable screens for your team and your customers
  • Review sessions until it works the way you work
  • Sign-off on the full flow before build starts
03Build

Progress you can click through every week

  • Built in short weekly cycles
  • A test link that updates every week
  • Weekly check-in call and written update
  • Your feedback goes into the next week
04Pilot

Tested with real shipments

  • Live shipments and one ATM job run through it
  • Your team uses it day to day
  • We fix and polish what the pilot shows
  • Security and access checks before launch
05Launch

Go live with support

  • Customers, shipments and invoices moved in
  • Training for each team
  • Customers invited to their accounts
  • 6 months of support after launch
